name: Amark Wire
old_description: For over 50 years, Amark Wire has been a recognized leader in the custom manufacturing of wires, pins, and cables. We specialize in smaller, more difficult products that are used across many different industries and in some of the most critical applications.
about:
Based in Fairfield, New Jersey, Amark Wire has spent more than five decades as a specialist in the custom manufacture of wires, pins, and cables. The company focuses on smaller, technically demanding components that serve critical applications across multiple sectors.

Its capabilities span drawing, grinding, straightening, cutting, forming, and spooling of small-diameter wire rod, holding tolerances from 0.002 inch to 0.250 inch in diameter and lengths up to 12 feet. The shop runs Escomatic Swiss screw machines, four-slide equipment, centerless grinders, wire EDM, and a range of secondary operations including flattening, heading, precision bending, sand blasting, tumbling, upsetting, threading, and cold forming.

Customers come from automotive, aerospace, defense, dental, medical, electrical, fiber optics, glass sealing, and earth and environmental sciences. The firm supplies conductors, drawn wire, electrical pins, electrodes, eyelets, hermetically sealed pins, guide wire, hinge pins, inserts, micro welding wire, rods, shafts, springs, step pins, studs, stylets, thermocouple wire, and tubing.

Amark Wire emphasizes domestic production — all materials and products are manufactured in the USA — and promotes fast turnaround times and competitive pricing as key differentiators. Original material certifications and test reports are maintained on file, and customer drawings are kept confidential.
